files.tests/test_greeting.py:
import pytest

from greeting import greet


def test_greeting():
    assert greet("  Ada  ") == "Hello, Ada!"
    assert greet("世界") == "Hello, 世界!"


def test_blank():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        greet("   ")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        greet("")


def test_type():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        greet(None)
